contentPattern.structure: category + heading + CTA | background-image per slide

suitableFor: featured story carousels with split text/image layout
operations or technology showcase carousels on dark backgrounds
article carousels with category label, heading, and CTA alongside large background image
notSuitableFor: standard article card carousels with image-top layout (use carousel-article instead)
hero-style full-screen carousels with video (use carousel-hero instead)
